title: Port Hamilton incident
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Port Hamilton incident", at revision 1373838536, opens: "The Geomun Island incident or the Port Hamilton incident was the military occupation of Geomundo, Korea, by the British Royal Navy from 15 April 1885 to 27 February 1887." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5371343, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1885–1887 British intervention in Korea". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
